messages:
sarah-cs: quick heads-up — we observed rising ECC counters followed by intermittent Xid 43/79 on the eu1-dedicated-03 GPU pair. planning a graceful warm-failover to standby capacity and a physical card replacement. drafting customer comms now.

james-sre: +1. root pattern looks like ECC CRC accumulation then kernel Xid spikes. ops plan: mark VM pair degraded, drain container tasks, shift LB cookie to standby. in-flight requests should resume quickly; streaming sessions may reconnect within ~3-8s.

linus-runtime: runtime note: KV cache will remain consistent if the client reconnects promptly. streaming clients may see a brief token backoff; we should advise clients to retry. recommend we mention transient reconnects in the customer message.

maria-account: who is currently allocated on those hosts? need the tenant list so we can do targeted comms instead of a broad blast.

ops-bot: allocation lookup complete for eu1-dedicated-03. Tenants: ["acme-ai", "finlytics", "playgrid"]. Owners: sarah@acme.com, ops@finlytics.com, infra@playgrid.com. Report id: 20241002-eu1-03.

sarah-cs: perfect. i'll prepare two versions: (1) targeted note to acme-ai + finlytics offering reschedule and points of contact; (2) a lighter general notice for playgrid and the wider dedicated pool 30m before ops start.

legal: wording check: do NOT promise credits or SLA remediation. prefer "we expect" vs "we guarantee". add explicit line: "No customer model weights or stored data will be modified as part of this work."

sarah-cs: updated draft line: "We expect to perform a graceful warm-failover of your Dedicated nodes in eu-west-1 (eu1) starting 2024-10-02T02:00Z. Most workloads should continue without interruption; some long-lived streaming sessions may briefly reconnect (seconds). No customer model weights or stored data will be modified as part of this work. If this window is unacceptable, reply with preferred alternatives."

james-sre: ops checklist (short): 1) set node state=DEGRADED; 2) signal scheduler to drain new tasks from those hosts; 3) update LB cookie routing to standby pool; 4) verify KV cache handoff for active chats; 5) issue power-cycle and coordinate card replacement. rollback: restore drained tasks if any unexpected failures.

linus-runtime: add mitigation for customers: reduce batch size, enable smaller response tokens, or fall back to a lower-quant model to reduce latency risk during failover. also note: streaming clients should implement an idempotent reconnect.

sarah-cs: logistics: vendor replacement ETA is variable; expect tech onsite or remote flash within +2-4h depending on parts. estimated maintenance window 45-90 minutes. planned start 2024-10-02T02:00Z. we'll post a 30m reminder and a live status link during the window.

maria-account: i'll send the targeted emails to acme-ai and finlytics now. include cs-ops@redwood.com as contact and the ops incident link. playgrid will receive the general notice.

ops-manager: confirm monitoring playbook: create temporary dashboard for ECC/Xid telemetry, raise an alert if post-failover ECC doesn't clear within 15m, assign on-call @james-sre and @linus-runtime for the window.

james-sre: I'll post the minimal runbook/commands in this thread: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=ecc.errors.uncorrected --format=csv`, `dmesg | grep -i Xid`, and an example drain command: `schedulerctl drain --node eu1-dedicated-03 --grace 30s`.

sarah-cs: final call: any objections to sending targeted notices now and the general 30m broadcast before the operation? if no objections by EOD we'll proceed. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: scheduled message queued: targeted-notice -> acme-ai, finlytics (sent). general broadcast queued for 2024-10-02T01:30Z.
